Game Overview

In Pumpking vs Mummy, the core idea is straightforward: get ready for a pixelated Halloween face-off in Pumpking vs Mummy. Choose your character, collect pumpkins and candies, and race to deposit balloons for coins. Speed and strategy are your allies in this exhilarating arcade clash. Capture victory to unlock whimsical hats and outsmart your opponent!
